assemblySteps.title: Assemble Chassis Plate and Compute Bay
assemblySteps.summary: Mount the Jetson Nano compute housing, structural crossbar, and rear bus connector onto the chassis base plate.

assemblySteps.title: Install Wheel Brackets, Axles, and Actuators
assemblySteps.summary: Attach both wheel brackets, fit the steering servos, and align each drive actuator with its axle flange.

assemblySteps.title: Mount the Stereo Camera and Navigation IMU
assemblySteps.summary: Secure the ZED 2i forward of the compute bay and seat the navigation IMU below the base plate.

assemblySteps.title: Mount the Carrier, Motor Controller, and Battery
assemblySteps.summary: Seat the Jetson carrier in the compute bay. Secure the motor controller and battery below the base plate.

assemblySteps.title: Route Battery and DC Power
assemblySteps.summary: Connect the 3S pack to the distribution board. Connect its outputs to the carrier and rear coupler.

assemblySteps.title: Route Camera, Steering, Drive, and Sensor Cables
assemblySteps.summary: Connect the camera and steering servos to the carrier. Connect the carrier UART, navigation IMU, and drive actuators to the motor controller.
